text2cypher.query: MATCH (v:Venue) RETURN count(v)

MATCH (p:Player)-[:receivesAward]->(a:Award)
RETURN DISTINCT p.name

MATCH (pelicans:Team {name: "New Orleans Pelicans"})-[:partOfDivision]->(division:Division)
MATCH (team:Team)-[:partOfDivision]->(division)
RETURN team.name

MATCH (team:Team {name: "Los Angeles Clippers"})-[:hasHomeVenue]->(venue:Venue)
RETURN DISTINCT venue.name
MATCH (p1:Player {name: "Herm Gilliam"})-[:playsFor]->(t:Team), (p2:Player {name: "Scoot Henderson"})-[:playsFor]->(t) RETURN t.name, t.owners

MATCH (p:Player {name: "Scott Padgett"})
RETURN p.country_of_citizenship

MATCH (p1:Player {name: "Isaac Bonga"}), (p2:Player {name: "Linas Kleiza"})
RETURN p1.height_cm - p2.height_cm AS height_difference

MATCH (buddy:Player {name: "Buddy Hield"})-[:receivesAward]->(buddyAward:Award)
WITH COLLECT(buddyAward) as buddyAwards
MATCH (player:Player)-[:receivesAward]->(award:Award)
WHERE award IN buddyAwards AND player.name <> "Buddy Hield"
WITH player, COUNT(award) as awardCount
RETURN player.name, awardCount
ORDER BY player.name
MATCH (v:Venue) RETURN v.name

MATCH (p:Player)-[:draftedBy]->(t:Team)
RETURN p.name
ORDER BY p.mass_kg DESC

WHERE team <> wizards
RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT team)

MATCH (d:Division)-[:partOfConference]->(c:Conference {name: "Eastern Conference"})
RETURN count(d)

MATCH (p1:Player {name: "Bulbs Ehlers"})-[:playsPosition]->(pos:Position)
MATCH (p2:Player {name: "Derek Anderson"})-[:playsPosition]->(pos)
RETURN DISTINCT pos

MATCH (p:Player {name: "George Lehmann"})
RETURN p.date_of_birth

MATCH (p1:Player {name: "Mark McNamara"}), (p2:Player {name: "Chris Paul"})
RETURN p1.handedness, p2.handedness, p1.handedness = p2.handedness

MATCH (joel:Player {name: "Joel Kramer"})-[:playsPosition]->(pos:Position)
WITH joel, COLLECT(pos) as joelPositions
MATCH (player:Player)-[:playsPosition]->(position:Position)
WHERE position IN joelPositions AND player <> joel
WITH player.name as playerName, COUNT(DISTINCT position) as posCount
RETURN playerName, posCount

MATCH (t:Team)
RETURN t.name

MATCH (p:Player)-[:playsPosition]->(pos:Position)
WHERE pos.name = "point forward"

MATCH (p:Player {name: "Bob Dandridge"})-[:draftedBy]->(t:Team)

MATCH (warriors:Team {name: "Golden State Warriors"})-[:partOfDivision]->(div:Division)
MATCH (clippers:Team {name: "Los Angeles Clippers"})-[:partOfDivision]->(div)
RETURN div.name

MATCH (t:Team {name: "Golden State Warriors"})

MATCH (p1:Player {name: "JaVale McGee"}), (p2:Player {name: "Kevin Grevey"})

MATCH (award:Award {name: "Kareem Abdul-Jabbar Award"})
